title: Pierre-Emile Højbjerg Transfer Updates: Newcastle, Marseille, and Aston Villa
description: Recent reports indicate transfer activity involving Pierre-Emile Højbjerg with Newcastle United, Marseille, and Aston Villa, according to various sports news outlets.

sources.title: Newcastle United close to completing Jordan Henderson-style summer transfer
Newcastle hit new low as Hojbjerg rejects move and Aston Villa 'advancing' for back-up signing
Marseille and Newcastle nearing €15m deal to complete Pierre-Emile Højbjerg move

sections.heading: Newcastle and Marseille Deal Reports
paragraphs: Get French Football News reports that Marseille and Newcastle are nearing a €15m deal to complete Pierre-Emile Højbjerg's move. Additionally, FourFourTwo states that Newcastle United is close to completing a 'Jordan Henderson-style' summer transfer.

sections.heading: Rejection and Aston Villa Interest
paragraphs: Football365 reports that Newcastle has hit a new low as Hojbjerg rejects a move. The same source notes that Aston Villa is 'advancing' for a back-up signing.

sections.heading: Search Interest Data
paragraphs: Google Trends data indicates a search lower bound of 1000 for the term 'pierre-emile højbjerg' in the GB region. The trend feed was published on August 10, 2026.

faq.q: What is the reported transfer fee for Højbjerg?
faq.a: Get French Football News mentions a €15m deal nearing completion between Marseille and Newcastle.

faq.q: Did Højbjerg accept the move to Newcastle?
faq.a: According to Football365, Hojbjerg rejected the move to Newcastle.
